purpose: Convert explicit CAPABILITY_SELECTOR_COMPOSITION_V3 decisions into auditable test-only method invocations without granting authority or conflating test handlers with governed method implementations.
preconditions: selector receipt structurally valid with execution_authorized=false and admission_required=true
independent permission resolver verifies permission receipt for the exact execution_id and test scope
permission receipt includes allowed_method_ids covering each selected method
independent selection verifier authenticates the selection output using the caller's trusted evidence
selected method is active and auto_select=true in the source registry, with verified precondition receipt
all selected methods have explicit handler, executor_id, source_revision, execution_contract_ref, method-specific typed input
independent result verifier evaluates each method output; a self-reported VERIFIED field is insufficient
all selected handlers are preflighted before any method is invoked; no partial missing-binding dispatch
fail_closed: no selected method while some matching methods were rejected
deferred_for_governed_runtime: bind real method_id to type-checked production implementations, not similar-named helpers
complete independent authority permission resolution with signed/readback references
enforce per-method runtime timeouts and side-effect idempotency
persist method receipts in governed append-only ledger
prove registry liveness and semantic routing with live traces
execute controlled D1/D2/D3 E2E on new blind holdout
